content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Makes asphalt plants and aggregate equipment for road builders and quarries, not rail track products or services."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Road and highway paving contractor with its own asphalt and quarries; no rail products or rail customers."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Municipal street sweepers, sirens and public safety vehicles; sells to municipalities, not railroads."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Broad plumbing, HVAC and waterworks distributor to contractors; no rail track components or rail services."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Industrial pumps, valves and seals for process plants; different products and customers from rail infrastructure."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures new railcars and repairs them; rail-adjacent but builds rolling stock rather than track products and services."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Asphalt plant manufacturer for road builders and producers; no rail products or rail customers."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Highway and water heavy civil contractor with aggregates and asphalt; different construction business from rail products."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Diversified pumps, valves and connectors; its rail exposure is only brake friction components within a broader industrial business."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Switchgear and substations for power distribution; electrical equipment rather than rail infrastructure."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"HVAC, UV disinfection and detection instruments; transit fare systems are a minor line, not core rail infrastructure."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Railcar manufacturing, leasing and highway guardrail; shares rail and DOT customers but not track components or rail services."}]}
